Interface Chunk
All Superinterfaces:

,

public interface
Chunk
extends
PersistentDataHolder
Represents a chunk of blocks.

 If the chunk is not yet fully generated and data is requested from the chunk,
 then the chunk will only be generated as far as it needs to provide the
 requested data.
